description: Look up ONE x402 seller by origin, host or URL (e.g. "api.exa.ai" or "https://stableenrich.dev") and get Factline's nightly probe history (per-day ok/latency), uptime, listed payTo wallets, and a health reading. Check this before paying a seller. A seller Factline does not track returns found:false ("not tracked yet"), which means UNKNOWN, not healthy and not unhealthy. Returns source and data_as_of (date of the latest probe; null with retrieved_at when the seller is not tracked).

origin.description: Seller origin, host or any URL on the seller (e.g. "api.exa.ai")

name: x402_seller_lookup
